RESULT

This is a normal result for this assay.

Limitations: chromosomal microarray detects copy number changes only. It does not detect
sequence-level variants, balanced rearrangements, repeat expansions, uniparental disomy
without a copy number change, or low-level mosaicism. A normal microarray does not
exclude a monogenic cause; further testing may be indicated on clinical grounds.
